checks.explanation: The trend continued through the 2024 election: Trump nearly doubled his share of Black voters (8% in 2020 to 15% in 2024) and cut the Democratic margin among Hispanic voters from 25 points in 2020 to 3 points in 2024, per Pew's validated-voter study and NBC/NPR exit-poll analysis.
